title.zh: 国内中转机房宕机自动容灾（Failover）实测：秒级故障转移机制对出海业务的重要性
title.en: Relay Server Automatic Failover Benchmark: Sub-Second Disaster Recovery for Critical Cross-Border Tasks

cluster.zh: 多线 BGP 智能中转与入口调度集群

description.zh: 实机模拟国内 POP 节点断网、DDoS 攻击与机房割接，深度剖析 HAProxy 健康检查、Keepalived 虚 IP 漂移与客户端自动 Fallback 策略组如何在 800ms 内实现无感容灾。
description.en: Simulating ingress fiber cuts, DDoS attacks, and maintenance events to evaluate HAProxy health probing, Keepalived VIP failover, and client-side fallback policies under 800ms.
